notes.title: Somber Echoes content update and news
notes.content:
[p]July 8th, marks the release of Somber Echoes on Playstation and Xbox, but also a significant milestone in our post-release efforts. We would like to seize the opportunity to thank every single one of our players for your constructive feedback and encouraging words. [/p][p][/p][p]Paying close attention to your feedback, we focused our efforts on addressing the most reported concerns in the update that was released on June 27th, and the one update that we are releasing today. We are also introducing some extra content that we hope will satisfy those among you that enjoy an extra challenge.[/p][p][/p][p]As a reminder, the highlights of our previous patch are:[/p][list][*][p]District outlines, traveling between all rest shrines and an item locator feature to make finding your way around the Atromitos even easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to lantern traversal and the Supernova ability that make exploration smoother and even more enjoyable.
[/p][/*][/list][p]With our Playstation and Xbox release, all versions of Somber Echoes are receiving the following additional content in the form of challenges:[/p][list][*][p][b]Speedrun modes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Make your way to and defeat the Phoenix boss[/p][/*][*][p]Start from scratch and get to the final boss[/p][/*][*][p]With a full loadout and every door unlocked from the start, hunt down and defeat all bosses[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss challenges[/b][/p][list][*][p]Varying difficulty boss fights with a predetermined loadouts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Supernova puzzles[/b][/p][list][*][p]7 traversal puzzles that will challenge you problem solving skills as well as your mastery of the Supernova mechanic
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeIEZinkCJ4yQQQLQZ3HePpkGvNmA1GUPw9uFWgtgM9OCt55O1DLpVsxFS6nYS5K0wmBImYLkMsiEm3J_zvPn2IngGW0joqzmLaa65PXehUEjXOOo-KvwmvitlGwNQw-tuwGBpMhA?key=ffz4x7ugyh_ZRHYGPjkyfg"][/img][/p][p]Each of the challenges have varying unlocking conditions that vary from reaching a specific point in the game, or defeating a certain boss, to finishing the whole game once.[/p][p][/p][h2]Journal[/h2][p]Our initial intention with the presentation of the narrative in Somber Echoes was to keep it somewhat discreet and elusive, requiring players that cared for it to pay some attention to figure out what had happened. At the same time it would be out of the way for more action oriented players.[/p][p][/p][p]Reacting to your feedback about the story being too elusive, we are adding a brand new inventory tab called Journal. It keeps track of all important storylines and also provides context in the form of Adrestia’s insights into the evolving narrative. 
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdsmJ8wLHTFfJVtZq7UmrGUoJ2l6RzrygHoc2fAVIBIXO8igZSgE2JZkirOJnwEXRBij0ubgufppBYiHwip6pVxLbgTL8-cO386SukoOcolSDcBu11qtVXZCHqV8sueOSUPeSUkLw?key=ffz4x7ugyh_ZRHYGPjkyfg"][/img][/p][p]Journal nodes are filled in as you progress through the game and discover narrative moments. Each node may have various story tidbits associated with it, which will be linked together, to give you the complete picture of what has happened, and what Adrestia’s reaction to the unfolding events is. The journal can be opened at any time to serve as an overview of where the story has taken you so far, or to jog your memory about a specific narrative point.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you will enjoy the new challenges and that the fixes and additions of the latest two patches address your most prominent feedback. We remain devoted to acting on your continued feedback to make Somber Echoes the best it can be.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you![/b] [/p]

tags.feature: - District outlines, traveling between all rest shrines and an item locator feature to make finding your way around the Atromitos even easier.
- Improvements to lantern traversal and the Supernova ability that make exploration smoother and even more enjoyable.
- Speedrun modes
- Boss challenges
- Supernova puzzles
- Reacting to your feedback about the story being too elusive, we are adding a brand new inventory tab called Journal.

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Update #7 - June 2025
notes.content: [h3]Map system updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Powering up any of the Circe Chambers will reveal the outline of the entire district that the chamber is associated with.[/p][/*][*][p]Added two new Circe Chambers one for the Cesspit and one for the Higher Residence district.[/p][/*][*][p]An item locator feature has been added to the Circe Chambers functionality:[/p][list][*][p]To activate the feature you need to power up the Circe Chamber close to the end of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Once activated, the Item Locator will be available to all Circe Chambers.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Circe Chamber reveals the location of Upgrade materials, Survivors, Nyx Fragments and Necklace Pieces within the district it belongs to.[/p][/*][*][p]Locating an item through this feature incurs a fixed Favor cost per item.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Fast Travel updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Adrestia can now fast travel between any discovered shrines with the following condition:[/p][list][*][p]To fast travel to and from any shrine, you must have activated the Circe Chamber for both the origin and destination districts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Lantern traversal updates:[/h3][list][*][p]The collision when exiting an Aether Lantern has been improved:[/p][list][*][p]This will result in less unwanted collisions with level corners and ledges when using the lantern to traverse the levels.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The “grace period” and conditions for exiting the Supernova state has been made more generous:[/p][list][*][p]When you hit a surface head on while in the Supernova State, Adrestia will remain in the state for longer, allowing you a longer time to react.[/p][/*][*][p]When you hit a surface at a very shallow angle while in the Supernova State, the vector of your trajectory will be made parallel to the surface, allowing for nailing puzzles that stretch for long distances more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]In general these changes should make our more challenging puzzles a bit more manageable and less frustrating.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]System:[/h3][list][*][p]Added an option to adjust the timing of damage received [/p][list][*][p]This change is mainly aimed at TV or other slower refresh rate/higher latency monitor players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Patch #5
notes.content:
[b]QoL map updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an icon indicating where you last died.
[*] Shuttles and portals will now show their destination.
[*] Overall map fixes.
[*] Quest markers are added in a clearer way.
[/list]
[b]Controller updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added controller vibration, intensity can be changed in Options - Controls.
[*] It is now easier to aim straight using the D-Pad on a controller.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various bug fixes.
[*] Fixes to menus
[*] Fixes to various enemies and bosses.
[*] Improvement to overall stability

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Patch #4 - Early game adjustments
notes.content:
[b]Balance changes to help ease players into the early parts of The Lower Residence, as well as removing some frustration throughout.[/b]

[list]
[*] Added more Nyx crystals to help with health recovery in the early parts of Lower Residence.
[*] Removed a few projectile based enemies in one of the early levels.
[*] Moved the rest shrine in Plundered Market, to make it easier to spot.
[*] Changed Nocturnal Pools to no longer do damage to the player. They will still move you to the previous “safe spot”.
[/list]

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Patch #3
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes - Bosses and weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with attacks lingering on Stymphalian Statue
[*] Fixed an issue where the Arbiter weapon would in specific cases, do much more damage than intended.
[/list]
[b]Map updates(Icons/Readability)[/b]
[list]
[*] Added icons for survivors
[*] Updated the “quest” map icon to make it more visible
[*] Fixed some instances of “quest” icons not being properly removed
[*] Improved the color coding and contrast for the whole map
[*] When a “quest” is unlocked, the map will focus on the exact location of it
[/list]
[b]Level transition stability[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some edge cases where issues could arise from performing certain actions when transitioning 
between levels
[/list]
[b]Preparation for cloud save[/b]
[list]
[*] In between step to prepare the game for cloud save activation
[/list]
[b]Game save state[/b]
[list]
[*] Rescuing survivors will now save their state immediately
[*] Unlocking a statue memory will now save its state immediately
[*] Fixed some secret areas not saving their state after being hidden
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaks and polish applied to various cutscenes and animations
[*] Updated icons for button press prompts in tutorials and hints
[*] Added a tutorial for Aether Strips.
[/list]

notes.title: Second Big Patch live now!
notes.content:
[b] Fast Travel update:  [/b]

[list]
[*] Fast travel between Rest Shrines and C.I.R.C.E Chambers in the same district are now linked.
[*] Added a rest shrine near [spoiler] The Grove Shuttle area.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[b] Progression improvements [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some map elements and breakable walls linked to secrets, to help progressing the critical path.
[*] To ensure checkpoints are updated, we added an automatic save when walking past rest shrines. 
[*] Added an additional rest shrine in Lower Residence, to smooth out the early section.
[*] Added map icon for [spoiler] Hephaestus’s Workshop. [/spoiler]
[/list]
[b] Supernova grace period [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a slight grace period when hitting walls. This will help entering Aether Lanterns that are very close to walls.
[/list]
[b]Some enemy hitboxes were adjusted.[/b]
[b]Various bug fixes.[/b]

notes.title: First Big Patch live now!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Update to base hover skill. Before, Hover and Hover boost had different ways of activating, but they are now unified. It now activates by holding the jump button while jumping/zapping, instead of having to release and press again (in the case of base hover).
- Also does not deactivate by doing a downwards move input.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get stuck inside Radiant surfaces while using supernova and lightstream.
[*] Fixed an issue where a certain statue was not saved as found.
[spoiler] - If this happened to you, it should be fixed by going back to The Maiden statue to retrigger the cutscene. [/spoiler]
[*] Solved an issue where the map would sometimes automatically start moving when you open the map.
[*] Improved cutscene stability.
[*] Currently unsupported languages now default to English.
[*] Solved an issue where the aim effect on certain abilities would increase in intensity, resulting in obstructing view.
[*] Bug fixes on various enemies.
[*] Improvements for SteamDeck
[*] Tutorial Video support for SteamDeck.
[/list]
